svg.text: The SMART Study · set-up guide
Route C: Your child has an Android phone, and you have an Android or iPhone
Get the Family Link app
2 minutes · on your phone
1. Open the Play Store (Android) or the App Store
(iPhone).
2. Search for Family Link and install it.
3. Open it and sign in with your own Google Account
(often ending in @gmail.com).

g.text: Set screen time limits · Manage apps

svg.text: Link your child's account
10 minutes · on both phones
1. On your child's phone, open Settings, tap Google,
then All services.
2. Under Kids & family, tap Parental controls.
3. Tap Get started (or Let's do this) and choose your
child's account.
4. Follow the prompts, entering your own Google Account
when asked for a parent.
5. Your child taps to agree, and enters their own
password to confirm.
Allow only the apps on the
list
10 minutes · on your phone, in Family Link
1. Open Family Link → your child → Controls → Screen
time.
2. Turn on Downtime (called School time in some
versions).
3. Tap Weekly schedule → choose a day → Start 12:00 AM,
End 11:59 PM → Apply to all days of the week.
4. Tap Allowed apps → turn on Unlimited apps → Select
apps.
5. Set each app on your list to Unlimited time.

g.text: Who your child can talk to
Also called School time on some versio…
Apply to all days of the week

svg.text: Allow only the websites they
need
5 minutes · on your phone, in Family Link
1. In Family Link, go to Controls → Content
restrictions → Google Chrome.
2. Choose Only allow approved sites, then add the sites
on the list under Approved sites.
3. Block other browsers: Screen time → App limits → tap
each browser → turn Allowed off.
If a homework site won't load, don't switch the filter off.
Email smartphonestudy@public.io and we'll add it to the
shared list.

g.text: Add the sites on the list

svg.text: Lock the settings
3 minutes · on your phone, in Family Link
1. In Family Link, go to Controls → Content
restrictions → Google Play.
2. Under download approvals, choose All content, so
nothing new can be installed without your approval.

g.text: Approval needed for free and paid downlo…

svg.text: Check it worked
2 minutes · on your phone
1. In Family Link, open your child's profile.
2. If it shows their phone and recent activity, the
link is live.
3. If it shows nothing after a few hours, check the
phone is switched on, connected, and signed into the
supervised account.
